authority.statement: This report closes only the four committed frontend Approval baseline defects assigned to this work item. It does not authorize an HRIS module-session START, release, Gate, G4, or G6 transition.

findings.subject: product action disclosure shortcut contract
findings.before: approval-admin-overview duplicated workflow and operation route strings instead of consuming the canonical shortcut catalog objects expected by the disclosure contract.
findings.change: The overview now consumes PRODUCT_PAGE_SHORTCUT_TARGETS.approvalWorkflows and PRODUCT_PAGE_SHORTCUT_TARGETS.approvalOperations as complete product/surface/route targets. Existing current-authority revalidation, disclosure filtering, guarded navigation, and scoped-link construction remain in force.
findings.securityDisposition: No shortcut bypass or stale-authority fallback was introduced.

findings.subject: Approval form V2 cross-runtime golden fixture

provenance.decisionBasis: The committed Java resource and the pre-existing frontend expected pin agree byte-for-byte. The former frontend resource had the same parsed JSON values and schema digest but different whitespace. The Java bytes plus the already pinned digest are therefore the cross-runtime golden.

findings.change: The frontend resource is now the exact 5,101-byte committed Java golden and is listed in .prettierignore so formatter runs cannot silently alter the byte contract.

findings.subject: late planning cancellation contract
findings.before: The Approval planning test expected legacy free-text containing 'changed', while the hardened shared HTTP layer intentionally returns HttpTransportError with reason ABORT.
findings.change: The planning assertion now pins the typed HttpTransportError/ABORT contract and still verifies that the controller clears busy state.
findings.securityDisposition: No timeout, cancellation, response-body, retry, or request-dispatch behavior was weakened.

findings.subject: thirteen production-unreachable Approval modules
findings.before: The production reachability check rejected exactly thirteen committed Approval modules.
decisionBasis: The eight signature diagnostics UI modules formed only an internal dead chain and had no production route or composition root.

The backend source dwp-approval-server/src/main/java/com/dwp/services/approval/signatureproviders/SignatureProviderOperation.java explicitly classifies its vocabulary as proposed, not an installed registry or authorization grant.
The four route keys embedded in the proposed retention receipt client were absent from the committed frontend route/auth registry at the required base commit.
The installed and separately governed route.approvals.work.signature-command-receipt.data implementation was not removed; its shared client and ApprovalSignatureController consumer remain intact.

Wiring the dead modules without installed owner authority and transport would fabricate authority; adding an unused import would only evade the checker. Historical Git commits retain the proposals for a later independently authorized installation.
findings.securityDisposition: No allowlist exception, fabricated route, authority bypass, or fake composition was added.

fullVitest.warnings: Existing React act(...) test-harness warnings were emitted on stderr; no test failed. They are not suppressed or promoted as successful assertions.

discardedHarnessAttempt.detail: An initial combined formatting invocation used an unsupported selector. It changed no source and was replaced by direct Prettier checks, which passed.

residualGlobalBlockers.observed: architecture:check printed the existing production-readiness evidence state BLOCKED 0/37 while explicitly treating that step as schema/integrity-only; the architecture command still completed successfully.
residualGlobalBlockers.impact: This bounded Approval remediation is not a release-readiness attestation and cannot close evidence that requires external owners or environments.

residualGlobalBlockers.observed: Cross-repository provenance, canonical Gate state, and whole HRIS module-session START authority are controlled outside this branch.
residualGlobalBlockers.impact: The root integrator must combine this commit with the latest independently verified backend and blueprint evidence before making any overall decision.

finalVerdict.nextAction: Root integration may review and merge commit 31b42a6311296c4a4fcf28212f076658dce7b19e, then rerun canonical cross-repository and Gate validation.
